hero.title: Personalized Training Studio
hero.description_1: We are a training studio based in Funchal, Madeira, dedicated to promoting physical activity for everyone while helping you build strength and endurance.
hero.description_2: At Nódoa Negra, our trainers specialize in strength training, hypertrophy, and body composition improvement.
hero.description_3: Through challenging exercises that push your limits—and may leave some "bruises"—we're committed to improving your fitness and boosting your confidence.

features.title: Who We Serve
features.description_1:
Our personalized training services are designed for anyone seeking professional guidance, specialized coaching, privacy, and safety.
Whether you're just starting your fitness journey or are an experienced athlete, we welcome you to work toward your goals with us.
features.description_2: If you value a focused environment where you can concentrate on your personal goals, receive individualized attention, and feel comfortable throughout your training, you're in the right place. Our studio is thoughtfully designed to provide you with a unique experience where you'll feel supported and motivated to achieve your desired results.

training.title: Our Training Programs
training.description: We offer two distinct personalized training formats to suit your individual needs and goals.
training.note: Regardless of which format you choose, we carefully consider your needs and typically place new members in our Group Training program.
training.benefits: ** Both programs include training towel and coffee

training_group.title: Group Training
training_group.subtitle: Small group personalized training
training_group.description_1: We offer personalized training in small groups with a maximum of 3 clients at a time. Each group is led by a dedicated trainer who provides individualized attention to every participant.
training_group.description_2: This approach gives you the benefits of personalized training while enjoying a motivating atmosphere and mutual support with other group members.
training_group.description_3: We keep groups intentionally small to ensure you receive the guidance you need to reach your goals effectively.
training_group.vat_note: VAT at the current legal rate will be added to the monthly fee.
training_group.registration_desc: Fill out the form and we'll get in touch with you as soon as possible.
training_group.registration_contact: Feel free to contact us if you have any questions or would like to visit our studio.

training_individual.title: One-on-One Training
training_individual.subtitle: Personalized individual training
training_individual.description_1: Our one-on-one format is ideal for situations requiring exclusive attention, such as specific medical conditions or when you prioritize complete privacy during your workouts.
training_individual.description_2: In this format, you'll have a trainer dedicated entirely to you. Your trainer will create a personalized program tailored to your goals, current fitness level, and specific needs.
training_individual.description_3: This individualized approach ensures focused attention on your progress, with every session adapted to your abilities and limitations.
training_individual.registration_desc: Fill out the form and we'll get in touch with you as soon as possible.
training_individual.registration_contact: Feel free to contact us if you have any questions or would like to visit our studio.
